pages.text: Redstone alone starts visits to up to 16 finished tea blocks in a 15x15 area. No manual activation, input pool or mana fee is needed. Each visit takes 40 work ticks. Only consumed blocks count; redstone-off finishes the current visit. Output=N*3750*(1+0.25*(D-1)), 50% above the old default. Keep an output path. Repeated tea carries hidden risks; sealing does not remove them. Crafting returns the ascended bottle.
